title: Weighted geometric-sum inequality
statement: Let $\iota$ be a type, let $s$ be a finite subset of $\iota$, and let $w_i,a_i\geq0$ for every $i\in\iota$. For $0<\lambda<1$, one has $\sum_{i\in s}w_i a_i^{1-\lambda}\leq (\sum_{i\in s}w_i)^\lambda(\sum_{i\in s}w_i a_i)^{1-\lambda}$, with powers interpreted as real powers.
hypotheses_covered: $s$ is a finite subset of an index type
